Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
Regarding the card "Archon" I have notived that the Jyhad and V:tES
versions are contradictory, but I have not seen any errata that explicitly
addresses which version is correct.

Jyhad version has the blocking Methuselah pay one pool.

V:tES version has the blocking Vampire burn one blood (as in Camarilla
exemplary).

I assume the V:tES version takes precedence, but if so, I am still curious
as to why they changed it. Was this intentional, or an error?

Thanks

John W.
